snippet.title: Wishknot - First Trailer
snippet.description:
Swing, saw and squash your way through a procedurally generated world in this medieval physics soulslike. You've fallen down an endless wishing well with nothing but a rope and far too much momentum.

▶ Play the free demo / wishlist on Steam!

Wishknot is a 2D rope-physics soulslike. Your rope is your weapon, your movement and your lifeline: swing, anchor, tow, snare and crush anything heavier than you. Die, and the tears you carried stay where you fell. Fight your way back to claim them. Fill a soul basin, and it brings you back when you fall.

• One physical rope: swing, anchor, tow, snare, sling and crush
• Terrain you can reshape
• Bosses, lost survivors to rescue, stars, enchantments and curses
• Playable entirely with a mouse
• 14 languages, including Japanese, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Korean, German, French, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese

Free demo in Steam Next Fest until October 26, 2026.
Full game: December 25, 2026, on Windows and macOS.

Streaming and monetized videos are welcome, no permission needed.

Made by Guck, an independent studio.

#Wishknot #Soulslike #IndieGame #SteamNextFest #PhysicsGame
